_note: Hardcoded sample dataset of pesticides banned/restricted by India's CIBRC (Central Insectibles Board & Registration Committee). Used by services/pesticide_service.py. Not exhaustive -- always verify against the product label and local regulations.

banned.name: Endosulfan
banned.reason: Banned in India (2011-12). It is a persistent organic pollutant under the Stockholm Convention, harmful to human health and aquatic life.

banned.name: Phorate
banned.reason: Banned for most crops due to high acute toxicity; responsible for many accidental poisoning cases.

banned.name: Methyl Parathion
banned.reason: Banned due to high acute toxicity to humans and pollinators.

banned.name: Phosphamidon
banned.reason: Banned due to high toxicity and environmental persistence.

banned.name: Aldrin
banned.reason: Organochlorine insecticide banned under the Stockholm Convention on persistent organic pollutants.

banned.name: Dieldrin
banned.reason: Organochlorine banned under the Stockholm Convention; accumulates in the food chain.

banned.name: DDT
banned.reason: Banned for agricultural use in India (only permitted for public-health malaria vector control).

banned.name: Heptachlor
banned.reason: Organochlorine banned under the Stockholm Convention; persists in soil and accumulates in food.

banned.name: Chlordane
banned.reason: Organochlorine banned under the Stockholm Convention.

banned.name: Lindane
banned.reason: Banned for agricultural use; a persistent organic pollutant.

banned.name: Toxaphene
banned.reason: Banned under the Stockholm Convention on persistent organic pollutants.

banned.name: Triazophos
banned.reason: Banned for agricultural use due to high toxicity to humans and aquatic organisms.

banned.name: Quinalphos
banned.reason: Banned/restricted for many crops due to acute toxicity.

restricted.name: Chlorpyrifos
restricted.reason: Restricted: not permitted on vegetables and several crops; toxic to pollinators and aquatic life. Use only where specifically allowed.

restricted.name: Monocrotophos
restricted.reason: Restricted: banned on vegetables; highly toxic to birds and humans. Permitted only on specific crops at label dose.

restricted.name: Carbofuran
restricted.reason: Restricted: granular formulation banned due to bird mortality; toxic to users. Use only permitted crops/forms.

restricted.name: Dichlorvos
restricted.reason: Restricted: high mammalian toxicity; permitted only for specific uses at label dose.

restricted.name: Acephate
restricted.reason: Restricted on certain crops due to toxicity to pollinators and aquatic organisms.

restricted.name: Methomyl
restricted.reason: Restricted: high acute toxicity (a carbamate). Use only where permitted with full protective gear.

restricted.name: Paraquat
restricted.reason: Restricted: highly toxic herbicide with no safe antidote; licensed users only with PPE.

restricted.name: Glyphosate
restricted.reason: Restricted: use with care near water bodies and food crops; avoid drift. Follow state-specific limits.

restricted.name: Cypermethrin
restricted.reason: Restricted: highly toxic to fish and bees; observe pre-harvest interval and avoid aquatic contamination.

restricted.name: Carbendazim
restricted.reason: Restricted on several crops due to endocrine-disruption and residue concerns.
